craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of joined debate — Sāṅkhya fairly stated then page-turned. Sāṅkhya at full strength (presence-proof; self-aims denied). Rejected: (a) weakening opponent → killed: fairness before victory (rasa). Read aloud: PRA-dhā-NA STANDS-proved … PER-son-AIM-ness STANDS-proved.

lines: Pradhāna stands proved there, by presence and the rest —
denying self-aims and their kin, person-aim-ness stands proved.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asti cāsya pradhānasya prasiddhasyānvayādinā svārthatādiniṣedhena sādhitā puruṣārthatā

reads_against.argmap: How is pradhāna proved? → Sāṅkhya stated: pradhāna proved by anvaya; purposed to spirit by denying self-aims.
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
